notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: This page does not exist, or your role cannot open it.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.body: Sign in with your GitHub account. You must be a member of the organization.
signin.error.not_member: Your GitHub account is not a member of the organization.
signin.error.app_missing: The GitHub App does not exist yet. An admin must finish setup first.
signin.error.bad_state: The sign-in link expired. Start again.
signin.error.github: GitHub did not answer. Try again.
setup.title: Set up Sayso
setup.token.body: Enter the setup token. It is the value of SAYSO_SETUP_TOKEN on the server.
setup.token.label: Setup token
setup.step.app.hint: This step comes first. The other steps open after you sign in with GitHub.
home.title: Reviews
home.empty: No reviews yet. Sayso reviews pull requests after you set up the GitHub App.
access.title: Access
access.hint: Roles come from team mappings and direct grants. The highest role wins.
general.title: General
general.hint: Defaults, limits and budgets. Each change keeps its history.
general.invalid: The value is not valid JSON.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: Every change to settings, secrets, access and repositories. Nobody can edit it.
diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.hint: Checks of the database, Temporal, GitHub and outbound connections.
secret.env.unset: Not set in the API process
repos.title: Repositories
repos.hint: Repositories where the GitHub App is installed. Set the mode of each one.
repos.empty: No repositories yet. Install the GitHub App on one or more repositories.
repos.name: Repository
repos.mode.label: Mode
repos.mode.hint: Shadow runs the agent and posts nothing. Comment posts findings. Gate also fails the check on a blocking finding.
repos.mode.readonly: Only maintainers and admins change the mode.
repos.mode.failed: The mode did not change. Try again.
github.title: GitHub
github.hint: The GitHub App, its installations and the webhook deliveries.
github.app.none: The GitHub App does not exist yet. Create it in setup.
github.installations.none: The App is not installed yet.
setup.app.org.hint: Sayso creates a private App in this organization. GitHub asks you to confirm.
setup.error.bad_state: The App link expired. Start again.
setup.error.github: GitHub did not create the App. Try again.
signin.app_created: The GitHub App exists. Install it on the organization, then sign in.
models.title: Models
models.hint: Providers are model endpoints. Profiles choose the provider and model of each stage.
providers.title: Providers
providers.empty: No providers yet. Add one, then test it.
providers.name: Name
providers.models.hint: Model IDs, one per line. The first one is the test model.
providers.headers.hint: One header per line, as Name: value.
providers.no_tools: This provider cannot do tool calls. Profiles cannot use it.
profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.hint: Each profile tries its targets in order. A target needs a provider that passed the tool call check.
profiles.prices.hint: Prices are in USD per million tokens.
mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.hint: Agent runs reach these servers through the MCP proxy. Tools without the read-only hint stay blocked unless you allow them.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.headers.hint: One header per line, as Name: value. Put secret values in the secret field.
mcp.allow_write.hint: A tool without the read-only hint needs this switch and a matching pattern.
mcp.patterns.hint: One pattern per line, for example ticket_*.
mcp.tools.none: Test the server to list its tools.
repos.mcp.label: MCP servers
repos.mcp.hint: Agent runs of this repository can use the servers that you select. The .sayso.yml file can narrow this list.
repos.mcp.none: No MCP servers exist yet. Admins add them under MCP servers.
